verdicts.reason: A rebuilds the layout properly for the tall format: the logo and NEW VIDEO badge sit in a top row, then the large headline wraps cleanly over three lines, then the lime circle with the shoe, then the 'Full review inside.' line. Small flaws: the badge is a little tilted and crowds the top-right corner, the circle is slightly off-centre, and the space below the circle is tight. In B, the headline sits directly on top of the shrunken shoe/circle graphic and the badge overlaps the circle, both clear collisions. The hero image is squeezed into the top-right corner, and roughly two-thirds of the canvas is empty purple above a lone 'Full review inside.' line, so B can't be used.
